stemMarkdown: If 15 workers can complete a job in 10 days, how many days will 24 workers take to complete the same job, working at the same rate? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The job needs $15 \times 10 = 150$ worker-days. With 24 workers that takes $\dfrac{150}{24} = 6.25$ days. Workers and days vary inversely.
